def factor_trend_adaptive_smooth_efficiency_blend(df):
    '''Adaptive blend of intraday momentum and overnight reversal with smoothed trend-efficiency gate.'''
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy['close']
    open_ = df_copy['open']
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(close, open_)
    window = 20
    price_change = close.diff()
    abs_sum = price_change.abs().rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    net_change = close - close.shift(window)
    efficiency_ratio = net_change.abs() / abs_sum.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    efficiency_ratio = efficiency_ratio.fillna(0.0).clip(0.0, 1.0)
    efficiency_ratio_smoothed = efficiency_ratio.ewm(span=5, min_periods=1).mean()
    intraday_signal = intraday_ret.rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean()
    overnight_reversal = -overnight_ret.rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean()
    factor = efficiency_ratio_smoothed * intraday_signal + (1.0 - efficiency_ratio_smoothed) * overnight_reversal
    factor.name = 'factor_trend_adaptive_smooth_efficiency_blend'
    return factor
